h1: Lawn Mowing Canberra — Regular & One-Off Lawn Mowing
title: Lawn Mowing Canberra | Regular & One-Off Mowing
description: Lawn mowing Canberra wide: weekly, fortnightly or monthly visits, or a one-off cut. Clean edges, clippings can be taken away. Fully insured. Free upfront quote.
lede: Scheduled or one-off mowing with clean edges and a tidy finish, quoted upfront before any work starts.
intro: Down the Rabbit Hole AUST provides lawn mowing Canberra homeowners and businesses can put on a schedule or book once. The business is owned and run by Michael Robinson. It is fully insured, ABN registered and has maintained more than 60 Canberra lawns since it was established in 2021.

Our lawn mowing Canberra service covers Weston Creek, our priority area, along with Woden Valley, Tuggeranong, Belconnen, the Inner North, the Inner South and Queanbeyan. Quotes are free and given upfront. Below is what a visit includes, how regular schedules and one-off cuts work, and how mowing changes with the seasons. If the lawn needs more than a cut, see [lawn care](/lawn-care) for fertilising and weed control.

sections.h2: What is included in every mowing visit
paras: A mowing visit is more than a pass with the mower. The cut height is set to suit the grass type, so kikuyu and couch are kept shorter in summer while tall fescue mixes are left a little longer. Edges along paths, driveways and garden beds are trimmed so the lawn has a clean outline.

Clippings are blown off paths and driveways, and green waste removal is available with every mowing job, so you are not left with a full green bin or a pile by the fence. Lawn mowing Canberra wide should leave the yard tidy rather than just shorter, and that is the standard each visit is held to.
bullets: Mowing at a height suited to your grass type
Edging along paths, driveways and garden beds

paras: Start with a text or call to 0423 720 317, or use the form below. Tell us roughly how big the lawn is, the grass type if you know it and how often you want it cut. Every lawn mowing Canberra quote is free and given upfront before any work starts. There are no prices on this page because every lawn is different.

Once you are on a schedule, visits run on the agreed cycle without you having to rebook. Most Canberra lawns are best mowed every one to two weeks during the growing season and every two to four weeks in the cooler months. You can change the frequency at any time.
bullets: Change the frequency whenever you need to

paras: Not every lawn needs a schedule. A one-off cut suits a lawn that has got away over winter, a rental before an inspection, a house going on the market or a yard before a family event. Long grass is brought down in stages where needed so the lawn is not scalped, then edged and tidied.

One-off lawn mowing Canberra jobs are quoted the same way as regular visits: free and upfront. If the yard needs more than mowing, a [yard clean-up](/yard-clean-ups) covers overgrown beds, weeds and debris in the same visit.

Canberra lawns are cool-climate lawns, and lawn mowing Canberra wide follows the calendar more than the clock. From September the spring surge kicks in and a missed fortnight leaves a lawn shaggy. Summers are hot and dry, so the cut is kept a little higher to shade the soil and avoid scalping. From May to August hard frosts slow growth and visits can be spaced further apart.

Late winter and spring is when bindi and broadleaf weeds show up. Mowing helps but does not remove them, so if your lawn would benefit from [weed spraying](/weed-spraying) we will point it out. Autumn leaf drop from deciduous street trees means extra blowing and bagging on those visits.

Most mowing is residential, but Down the Rabbit Hole AUST also mows commercial properties, strata common areas and rentals managed by agents. For landlords and property managers, a standing lawn mowing Canberra schedule means one less thing to chase. You do not need to be home for a visit, as long as there is clear access to the lawn.

faqs.q: Do you offer lawn mowing Canberra wide or only in the south?
faqs.a: Weston Creek is our priority area, and we also mow in Woden Valley, Tuggeranong, Belconnen, the Inner North and the Inner South, and in Queanbeyan, Jerrabomberra and Googong. Gungahlin is outside the service area. Text or call 0423 720 317 with your suburb.
Green waste removal is available with every lawn mowing job. Clippings can be bagged and taken away so your green bin stays free for your own garden waste. Ask for it when you request a quote.

faqs.q: What height do you cut kikuyu, couch and fescue?
faqs.a: Kikuyu and couch are kept shorter through summer, while tall fescue mixes are left a little longer so the leaf shades the soil. The cut height is set to your grass type on the first visit and adjusted through the seasons.

faqs.q: What should I tell you about access before the first visit?
faqs.a: Locked gates, side-gate codes, dogs and anything fragile in the yard. With clear access you do not need to be home, and the job notes on the quote form are the easiest place to add these details.

faqs.q: Can an overgrown lawn be brought back down in one visit?
faqs.a: Usually. Long grass is brought down in stages where needed so the lawn is not scalped, then edged and tidied. If the yard needs more than mowing, a yard clean-up covers overgrown beds, weeds and debris in the same visit.
